Select approved drugs indicated for prostate cancer. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter by mesh_heading matching 'prostate cancer' and max_phase_for_ind equal to 4. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
